summary: Attackers created a phishing website impersonating the Solana based Avici platform and induced users to connect their wallets. Malicious transactions transferred more than 600000 dollars in crypto from victim wallets to attacker controlled wallets.
user_mistake: connected wallet to an impersonated Avici website and authorized malicious transactions
prevention: Open Avici only from a previously confirmed official domain / Reject wallet transactions that grant unexpected transfer permissions
